description: Review quorum per execution environment, as data (dispatch-contract D10). The supervisor copies the resolved entry into every request's review_requirements; a worker never lowers a quorum itself. A single-lane review is detected only by lanes failing to dispatch, never by reading environment variables or credentials, and records the degradation single_vendor_review (phase, vendor).

metered_lanes.description: Design D5 (openrouter-review-lane): a metered (OpenRouter) review lane is added only while fewer than fill_target non-metered lanes are selected. Each round reserves review_reservation_usd against the remaining spend ceiling before dispatch.

policies.sunset: Delete this entry, restoring quorum 2 everywhere, once API-based multi-vendor review (an OpenRouter integration) or the GX10 review lane is available to cloud workers.
